item.title: The Best Life Advice I’ve Ever Gotten – English with “SHOULD”
item.description:
【AI 精简版】 AI-trimmed version. An LLM deleted boilerplate sentences from the original article and left the rest verbatim. The original link at the end is the only authoritative source.

Why it is here: one short sentence

should and shouldn’t! In this lesson, I share some of the best life advice I’ve ever gotten, so you can hear “should” used in real, natural sentences. First, we look at various advice words and when they are used: must, have to, ought to, need to, might want to, could… and finally, “should”. You’ll also learn how to pronounce “should” (the “l” is silent!) and why we use a base verb after it (“You should take…”). Then I’ll give you my favourite pieces of life advice. What is the best advice someone has given you?
